State-wise Monthly GST Collection (2017–2026)

Source: R/data.R
gst_statewise.Rd

Monthly domestic GST collection broken down by state/UT and component, covering FY 2017-18 through FY 2025-26. Values in Rs. Crore.

gst_statewise

Format

A data.table with 4,306 rows and 11 columns:

financial_year

character. Financial year, e.g. "2023-24".

month

character. Month in "YYYY-MM" format.

month_date

Date. First day of the month.

state_code

character. Two-digit GST state code (zero-padded).

state

character. Full state/UT name.

region

character. Geographic region: "North", "South", "East", "West", "Central", "Northeast", or "Other".

cgst

numeric. Central GST (Rs. Crore).

sgst

numeric. State GST (Rs. Crore).

igst

numeric. Integrated GST (Rs. Crore).

cess

numeric. GST Compensation Cess (Rs. Crore).

total

numeric. Sum of all components (Rs. Crore).

Source

Ministry of Finance, Government of India. https://www.gst.gov.in

Examples

data(gst_statewise)
gst_statewise[state == "Maharashtra", .(month, total)][order(month)]
